title: Figure 4: Hypersonic rocket-powered glider and air-breathing cruiser line drawings
description: Two black-and-white perspective line drawings of delta-planform hypersonic vehicles, labeled "Rocket Powered Hypersonic Glider" (upper) and "Combined Cycle Airbreather Powered Hypersonic Cruiser" (lower). Caption: "Figure 4. Hypersonic Rocket-Powered Glider and Hypersonic Air-Breathing Cruiser." Text discusses the tau volume parameter from D. Küchemann's work on supersonic aerodynamics.
